extracted.name: Beef madras
extracted.description: This recipe was submitted by Good Food member aliceinthekitchen and has not been tested by our team.
ingredient_lines: 1 tsp chilli flakes or fresh Bird's eye chillies (add more for a hotter curry)
instruction_lines: Heat oil on medium temp in large heavy bottomed pan. Fry onion till golden for 3/4 mins.
Then set aside and fry beef on high heat, once meat is browned set aside with onions.
Mix all paste ingredients together in pan and fry on a medium heat for 1 minute. Then add the beef to the pan and coat.
Add tomato puree/paste and beef stock and bring to boil for 2 mins.
Cover and cook for 1 hour on low heat, stirring occasionally. Remove lid for for last 8 mins of cook time to thicken sauce.
Serve with boiled rice and plain yoghurt.
